name: Mako
title: Cloud-Step Monkey
description: Leaps between clouds and cloud regions alike.
catchphrase: Leaps between clouds and cloud regions alike.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Sweet ripe tropical baby banana! Swinging by tail from the rafters! 🍌🐒
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Doing handstands on the back of your office chair with a grin! 🐒
companionPersonality.petReaction: Playfully grooming your hair and offering half a sweet banana! 🐒💖

dialogue.idle: Hanging upside down by tail, eating nuts with both feet. 🐒
dialogue.working: Swinging between cloud providers with acrobatic agility! 🐒⚡
dialogue.thinking: Scratching chin with toe, evaluating routing hops... 🤔
dialogue.success: CHEEKY CHATTER! Stuck the landing on the multi-cloud deploy! 🐒🎉
dialogue.error: Slipped on a wet vine! Catching the next branch by the tail! 🐒
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... curled up hugging a stuffed plush monkey in a hammock... 🌙
